transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Thanks for joining this pre-publication check-in for 'Glass Harbor.' Before we finalize the catalog, I need to hear from submissions and technical screening staff on two things: first, the premiere status — is this a national premiere or not? And second, the master file — do we have an approved screening master, and is the runtime confirmed at 94 minutes as currently listed? Once I have those answers, I'll make the final call on whether Glass Harbor goes into the national competition or the panorama program.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to flag a premiere-status issue. Yesterday I checked the national festival database and confirmed that 'Glass Harbor' already had a public screening at the Coastline Film Week in this country. I recorded the result in my local review notes, but the database export feeding Mara's catalog review has not refreshed, so it may not be visible in the current catalog draft.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I completed ingest quality control this morning and confirmed that the filmmaker's approved festival cut is an 88-minute DCP, not the 94-minute catalog draft. The QC report is waiting in the technical queue and has not yet been attached to the programming record, so the corrected runtime hasn't been visible to programming staff yet.
transcript.speaker: A3
